name: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd

margin_definition.name: EBITDA margin (as reported)
margin_definition.source: management's reported margin for each quarter, on that quarter's results call (transcripts)

promises.quote: we are targeting to achieve 15% sustainable growth this year.
promises.actual: Q4 FY26 call, p.4: “IRCTC recorded its highest ever total revenue of Rs. 5,475 crores in FY 2025-26 compared to Rs. 4,904 crores in FY 2024-25 registering a year-on-year growth of 11.64%”; Q4 FY26 call, p.3: “During the financial year, revenue from operations of IRCTC stood at Rs. 5,215 crores, registering an increase of around 12% as compared to previous Financial Year 2024-25”
promises.why: Revenue grew 11.64% (R15) and ~12% (R11), both below the 15% target.
